card: This PR replaces the custom WalletLogPrintf() logging wrapper across wallet files with Bitcoin Core standard level-based logging macros (LogInfo, LogWarning, LogError). It introduces a WalletLogContext class so wallet-name prefixes remain intact while enabling proper severity level filtering. Additionally, it fixes -logsourcelocations for wallet code by attributing messages to actual call sites rather than the helper definition. The pull request is based on logging macro refactors in #34778 and #29256.
changed_since_previous: Rebased onto the updated base stack (#34778 and #29256), adapting to changes in the underlying `LOG_EMIT` macro and context hooks while keeping the wallet conversion intact.
evidence: PR description: 'The new logging macros introduced in #28318 weren't previously useful in wallet code because wallet code prefixes most log messages with the wallet names to be be able to distinguish log output from multiple wallets... This change makes -logsourcelocations usable with wallet code because it logs actual source locations instead of the WalletLogPrintf() location.'
Commit 1bdbe05a22 incorporates review suggestions to differentiate warnings and errors rather than logging everything at info level.
problem: Wallet log messages previously had to use `WalletLogPrintf()` to prepend wallet names for multi-wallet disambiguation. This forced all wallet logs into info level regardless of severity and broke `-logsourcelocations` by making every wallet log entry point to the wrapper function.

risk.why: Mistakes are confined to logging output and format strings, which are evaluated with compile-time format string checks.

scope_notes: This PR is stacked on top of #34778 and #29256. Only the last two commits in the branch are specific to this PR; the preceding commits belong to the underlying logging macro rewrite and context-argument infrastructure.
summary: Replaces the custom `WalletLogPrintf()` helper across the wallet subsystem with standard level-based logging macros (`LogInfo()`, `LogWarning()`, `LogError()`). To retain wallet-name prefixes without forcing all messages to info level, it introduces `WalletLogContext` inheriting from `util::log::Context`. It also fixes `-logsourcelocations` in wallet code so log lines record their true call site instead of the `WalletLogPrintf()` wrapper definition.
